Read [CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/nissifield/ftlbird-waypoint/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md) and preserve the [binding commitments](https://github.com/nissifield/ftlbird-waypoint/blob/main/README.md#architectural-commitments). This is design-stage only; do not submit deployment work, secrets, production logs, or personal data. For a security concern, use [SECURITY.md](https://github.com/nissifield/ftlbird-waypoint/blob/main/SECURITY.md) and keep the details private.

This is discovery and workflow review. No working product or production pilot is available.

## Setting and task

Describe an office, small organisation, or household in broad, non-identifying terms. What task is difficult today?

## Observations and consent

Separate observed FACT from ASSUMPTION, PROPOSAL, UNKNOWN, and RISK. For interviews, confirm consent for the anonymised summary. Do not attach recordings, personal records, contact details, or identifying screenshots.

## Desired outcome

What should an ordinary operator accomplish without AI or administrator expertise? How would you judge success and understand failure?

## Recovery and future evaluation

What would have to be understandable during a failed update, restore, or loss of remote access? What would a future pilot have to prove before consideration?

## Small next question

Link related research or Platform Contract discussion and suggest one focused question to investigate.
